pr_title: Cache ILM policy name on IndexMetadata
pr_body:
Closes #83582

One little detail is that the `LIFECYCLE_NAME` value is defined on [IndexMetadata](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/83603/files#diff-d9e713c7c9f70d3b97888b7ed019ba4469397004333b0d0c13fa98442beef047R822) but it's still almost entirely referenced by way of [LifecycleSettings](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/83603/files#diff-4e8f046e86e7ec85e51de358c9773903205bebc9b34afacaab5d7d479837a39cR20). We need to have the value available in IndexMetadata in order to pull the value from the settings and set it into `lifecyclePolicyName`, but besides that everything about this still seems more `LifecycleSettings`-related to me.
pr_comments: Hi @joegallo, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

issue_context.title: Make LIFECYCLE_NAME_SETTING a Field in IndexMetadata
issue_context.body: Just like we did previously in e.g. https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/78672 we can make the string in `LIFECYCLE_NAME_SETTING ` a field in `Indexmetadata` so we don't have to look it up for every index on every cluster state update in the lifecycle service. This setting alone currently takes almost 1% of the overall master runtime (and more than that in terms of wall-time I would assume) when creating the initial indices set during many-shards benchmarking: relates https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/77466

review_comments: It's just a cleanup commit. "While I was here", so to speak.
